status: Methods executed against repository data, not only literature proposals
acceptedMethods: Separate original model ownership from measured missing interior finishes before construction.
Use unique stationary architectural features and hold out different frames/points; reject a source gauge that only fits repeated logos or ceilings.
Audit camera travel, plumb lines and independently robust-fitted floor normals; subpixel reprojection alone did not detect false 26.566-degree floor tilt or multi-thousand-unit pose jumps.
Repair OpenMVS2.4.0 texture-ignore mask polarity in a separate input directory, preserving original reconstruction and mask receipts.
Fit bounded stationary planes; texture through calibrated SIMPLE_RADIAL projection into verified static-surface image masks; never use torn raw reconstruction for collisions.
Persist new Unity mesh and material assets before texture reimport; verify native rendering and actual CharacterController collision, not only reported import counts.
limitations: Source-model units are not certified survey metres.
Shared-video held-out samples are not an independent physical survey.
Public reference-image redistribution rights are not established.
Low-level surfaces and sparse reconstruction do not establish hidden tenancy boundaries or a complete traversable connector.
Whole user scene remains unsaved; observed finish geometry is persisted as an owned prefab and mesh/material assets.
